title: Non-operational EMP testing at SAMSO and Hill AFB
summary: Robert Salas tells of Non-operational EMP testing at SAMSO and Hill AFB, about 1960s-1970s at San Bernardino; Hill Air Force Base, Utah, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
place_text: San Bernardino; Hill Air Force Base, Utah

tellings.quote: of uh testing that was done uh on our kind of equipment, but it was done at a base like um uh Space Missile Systems Organization in uh San Bernardino Hill Air Force Base in Utah,

related.note: Both are about EMP testing on missile equipment as an explanation for the shutdowns. The WSJ account says an EMP was wheeled up to Malmstrom itself; Salas says such testing was done only at SAMSO and Hill AFB, not at operational bases.
